purpose: Non-admission discovery registry for satellite severe convection, lightning and hail proxy sources with distinct observational and research lineage.

entries.name: NASA SMASH European overshooting-top frequency
entries.spatial_scope: European domain; live monthly ImageServer extent approximately 32.29 to 60 N and -11.71 to 39.64 E
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Monthly, annual and hourly-binned OT days; monthly service pixel step 0.0357143 degrees, EPSG:4326
entries.note: Live macOS HTTPS metadata response verified ImageServer scientific service, extent and pixel size. Provider lists daily-occurrence aggregates, not individual OT time/position detections. Preserve calendar/hour bins, coverage, nodata and exact units; never treat OT days as hail days. Rights for exact layer and image export not yet reviewed; no raster bytes sampled. On 2026-11-25 bounded macOS HTTPS exportImage request (bbox 10,47,12,49; bboxSR/imageSR 4326; size 64,64; format tiff; pixelType F32; f image) returned image/tiff, 66342 bytes, SHA-256 371ce0ec153e6529cf32924c378fccf72f8bf174ce16bc4f01bc169fda31f659, little-endian TIFF magic; actual variable/time slice and raster values not inspected. Earlier no-raster statement refers to prior run; this is a derived service export not original provider raster. Do not use scientifically until slice/units/rights confirmed.

entries.name: NASA severe-storm-signatures OT/AACP software and training assets
entries.provider: NASA Langley / Cooney, Bedka and Liles
entries.spatial_scope: Geostationary imager domains; regional transfer unvalidated
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Semantic segmentation of overshooting tops and above-anvil cirrus plumes from satellite imagery and atmospheric inputs
entries.note: Paper https://doi.org/10.1175/AIES-D-24-0037.1; training labels, inputs and checkpoints listed at https://science-data.larc.nasa.gov/LaRC-SD-Publications/2023-05-05-001-JWC/data/. Repository contains License.pdf and License_Appendix.pdf; inspect code, checkpoints, training data and dependencies separately before reuse. Freeze commit, model config and sensor compatibility; compare MSG/MTG performance independently and correct parallax. OT and AACP are correlated severe-convection signatures, not surface hail labels; no code executed. On 2026-11-25 GitHub REST metadata identified license as Other / NOASSERTION, so inspect actual License.pdf and appendix rather than assume Apache. README documents native MTG-1 support from release V3 (April 2025), not verified MSG support; no inference run. Public checkpoint URL https://science-data.larc.nasa.gov/LaRC-SD-Publications/2023-05-05-001-JWC/data/ML_data.zip returned HEAD 200 application/zip, Content-Length 8182492479; too large for bounded sample, request smaller pinned weights or inspect archive index safely. No weights downloaded.

entries.name: Hong et al. near-global MODIS overshooting-top climatology
entries.provider: Hong, Nesbitt, Trapp and Di Girolamo
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 1 km thermal IR imagery; logistic OT detection model
entries.note: Original MODIS/CloudSat/GPM sources cited in study; downloadable derived individual OT catalogue not established. Polar-orbiting sampling and local overpass-time bias preclude continuous tracks. Obtain derived data or reproduce detection with observation opportunity normalization. Rights for source files and derived product separate.

entries.name: NASA Passive Microwave Hail Climatology V1
entries.spatial_scope: Global catalogue extent; actual observation coverage constrained by TRMM and GPM orbits
entries.temporal_scope: 1998-01-01 to 2026-03-31 per live CMR granules; TRMM through 2014-09-30; GPM from 2014-04-01
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 2-degree NetCDF-3 annual severe-hailstorm frequency estimates; three CMR granules
entries.note: Live CMR collection C2196515446-GHRC_DAAC returned COMBO_HailClimatology_BC2019_2deg.nc, TRMM_HailClimatology_BC2019_2deg.nc and GPM_HailClimatology_BC2019_2deg.nc with protected Earthdata URLs; metadata only, no NetCDF downloaded. Older NASA landing page ended March 2025; live CMR confirms March 2026. Severe-hail frequency inferred from passive microwave ice scattering; coarse climatology, not observed hail diameter or swath. Account, licence and granule variable/normalization check needed. Anonymous HEAD to the exact COMBO protected URL returned 303 to a CloudFront host on 2026-11-25, not a data payload. Earthdata login flow not completed; no access claim.

entries.name: GPM DPR Level 2A precipitation profiles V07
entries.spatial_scope: Approximately 70 S to 70 N orbital coverage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: HDF5 orbital swaths, nominal 5 km footprints; V07 hail classification
entries.note: Catalogue https://disc.gsfc.nasa.gov/datasets/GPM_2ADPR_07/summary; algorithm basis https://gpm.nasa.gov/sites/default/files/2022-06/ATBD_DPR_V07A.pdf. flagHail/flagGraupelHail are algorithmic hydrometeor indicators, not ground diameter. Validate exact field path and flags with small authenticated subset before bulk download; full granules large. Orbit sampling, attenuation and nonuniform beam filling matter.

entries.name: EUMETSAT MSG SEVIRI High Rate Level 1.5
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 12 spectral channels, historical 15-minute nominal imagery; latency-dependent availability
entries.note: Exact collection EO:EUM:DAT:MSG:HRSEVIRI. Preserve platform transitions, spectral response, scan timing, calibration and parallax; review historical archive completeness and product-specific licence before authenticated acquisition. Raw imagery, not OT catalogue. Pair with published OT detector rather than assuming GOES model transfers. Live anonymous EUMETSAT OpenSearch https://api.eumetsat.int/data/search-products/1.0.0/os with pi EO:EUM:DAT:MSG:HRSEVIRI, dtstart 2013-07-28T12:00:00Z, dtend 2013-07-28T12:30:00Z, c 1, format json returned totalResults 2; product MSG3-SEVI-MSG15-0100-NA-20130728122744.999000000Z-NA (12:15:11.055 to 12:27:44.999 UTC) with provider ZIP download link. Anonymous bounded range GET on exact advertised link returned HTTP 404; authenticated service test required, not evidence archive missing. No image data downloaded.

entries.name: WWLLN Global Lightning Climatology v2026.0.0
entries.resolution_or_granularity: NetCDF; monthly 5 arc-minute and 0.5 degree; daily 0.5 degree; stroke density and power
entries.note: Live Zenodo API returned 7 files totaling 3299540376 bytes, metadata license cc-by-4.0; deposit description explicitly states CC BY-SA 4.0. Treat rights as conflicting until publisher confirms; no WGLC data downloaded or admitted. README is 2747 bytes, 30m monthly climatology 27325956 bytes. Detection-efficiency-adjusted stroke density is not optical flash count; no event-level tracks or jumps. Do not generalize derived grid licence to raw WWLLN.

entries.name: NASA ISS Lightning Imaging Sensor quality-controlled V3
entries.note: CMR collection C3838944284-GHRC_DAAC. Intermittent ISS observation windows require exposure normalization; flash/stroke distinction and detection efficiency must be retained. Not continuous tracks. Exact granule rights and bytes untested.

entries.name: NOAA GOES GLM L2 events groups flashes
entries.temporal_scope: GOES-R era from 2017/2018; satellite-specific archive dates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Time-stamped optical lightning events, groups and flashes; NetCDF
entries.note: NCEI catalog gov.noaa.ncdc:C01527; public archive https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-goes/; data.gov metadata lists CC0 1.0 for this collection (formal rights review still open). On 2026-11-25 anonymous S3 prefix listing and one bounded original GET succeeded via macOS: https://noaa-goes16.s3.amazonaws.com/GLM-L2-LCFA/2024/167/12/OR_GLM-L2-LCFA_G16_s20241671200000_e20241671200200_c20241671200216.nc, 198460 bytes, SHA-256 ce0beb46fc01ea6e271f8c97eda042a8720452903a52ed7742f56c5111516506. HDF5 magic and h5py read passed; platform G16, FM1, coverage 2024-06-15 12:00:00 to 12:00:20 UTC, 71 flashes, 1189 groups and 2325 events. Verified flash_id, flash_lat/lon (degrees), flash_energy (J), flash_area (m2), flash_time_offset_of_first_event (seconds since granule start), flash_quality_flag, group_id and event_id. Counts are optical observations, not confirmed ground strikes or hail. Decode packed values, flags, parent-child relationships, viewing geometry, outages and sensor transitions before regional flash rates or tracks. No external bytes in Git or Neon, no scientific admission.

entries.name: TORRO / Hayward Northwest Europe thunderstorm catalogue
entries.provider: Hayward et al. / TORRO / UK Met Office ATDnet
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Tracked lightning clusters of at least three flashes; duration, motion, flash rate
entries.note: Publisher links a catalogue; paper https://doi.org/10.1002/joc.8123. Underlying Met Office ATDnet is third party; public link and open-access article do not establish commercial reuse. Confirm catalogue terms and file identity before downloading or ingesting. Thunderstorms are not hail events. Direct provider link https://www.torro.org.uk/pdf/Thunderstorm_catalogue_2008-2018_(LH).xlsx returned anonymous HEAD 200, XLSX content type and 16213773 byte length on 2026-11-25. No workbook bytes acquired pending exact reuse permission; underlying ATDnet terms remain open.

entries.name: KIT TRACE3D potential hail tracks Germany
entries.provider: KIT / Mohr et al. / DWD radar
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 15577 potential hail tracks from 3D radar PZ volumes
entries.note: Published 2026-02-06. Article validated against building insurance data; no public direct track-file link established. Data availability statement points to https://opendata.dwd.de/weather/radar/sites/pz/ and ERA5 regimes https://zenodo.org/records/17080146; confirm historic PZ access separately from operational directory. Paper does not provide hailstone diameter distribution. Request derived tracks and explicit rights or reproduce method with authorized radar archive.

entries.name: Giordani et al. OT and SPHERA hail-environment method
entries.provider: University of Bologna / KIT / NASA / ARPAE
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OT detections joined to convection-permitting reanalysis and hail reports
entries.note: Code https://github.com/agiord/hail-analysis; SPHERA from corresponding author; NASA OT data via provider request; ESWD reports separate restricted terms. Inspect code licence and verify exact feature definitions. No external data downloaded. Avoid circular validation against reports used for training. GitHub REST metadata on 2026-11-25 identifies hail-analysis repository licence as CC0-1.0; inspect actual licence and third-party dependencies before incorporating code. This does not grant SPHERA, NASA OT or ESWD dataset rights.

entries.name: NASA experimental US severe-weather OT/AACP product April 2025
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Experimental raster detections derived from GOES 500 m imagery at 5-minute cadence
entries.note: Provider marks product experimental. Time-aggregated repeated detections may indicate severe storm tracks but not hail swaths. Check exact raster service/licence and independent surface hail reports before quantitative use.
